text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, the day of the Yasuda Kinen arrived.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, Sweep Tosho
actually entered the race...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
And you're planning to enter the Takarazuka Kinen right after that!?
Are you for real...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: She runs the Triple Tiara route and is pretty small, too... but man, is she tough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Yasuda Kinen is another race where few Umamusume coming from the Triple Tiara route have claimed victory."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...She'd probably... pull it off, right?
I mean, it's Sweep Tosho we're talking about.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Because she is an Umamusume—
who shows us real magic!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, that's right.
Looks like you guys are finally starting to get it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you I can win the Yasuda Kinen, too!
And then—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna super-charge this spell and turn it into a hero-slaying weapon!!
